name: terminal

source.prompt: A realistic retail point-of-sale payment terminal angled three-quarter, its top card-reading face clearly visible, angled toward upper left. Blank smoked-glass display, recessed physical numeric-key shapes without glyphs, tiny contactless sign molded as abstract arcs; curved light-gray polymer shell and brushed-aluminum trim. No card, shop, cables or receipt.

method: Use aligned region mask and original neutral luminance. Model used neutral top-left light. Diffuse = min(1,1.2*luma^0.74), specular shoulder above .80, preserve original alpha and unmasked pixels. Region construction is recorded in palette.ts.
